label: 电耗记账 · 自动记录
info:
AE6 两电池交替充电自动记录：
1. 电量跳变≥90% → 换电：回填上条记录实际充后电量、存挂起数据、发通知
2. 插座>8W 开始会话（读累计电量起始值），<8W 持续2分钟结束
3. 结束读数差值算度数（回退功率积分）
4. <0.5kWh 视为插座他用，忽略且保留挂起数据
5. 正常结束生成记录 + 通知
6. GET /api/records、/api/status（含电量/里程）、POST /api/backup、GET /api/backups、GET /api/backup?file=...

name: ① 换电检测：电量跳变 ≥90%
info: sensor.zeeho_ae6_dian_liang 从 <90% 跳到 ≥90%，判定新电池装车，把跳变前电量与当前总里程存入挂起文件

name: 换电判定
func: const newS=Number(msg.payload),prevSoc=flow.get('prevSoc','file'),oldS=msg.data&&msg.data.old_state?Number(msg.data.old_state.state):(prevSoc!=null?Number(prevSoc):NaN);if(!isNaN(newS)){flow.set('prevSoc',newS,'file');flow.set('curSoc',newS,'file');node.status({text:'电量 '+newS+'%',fill:'green'});}if(isNaN(oldS)||isNaN(newS))return null;if(newS>=90&&oldS<90){flow.set('swapSocBefore',oldS,'file');node.status({text:'换电 '+oldS+'→'+newS+'%',fill:'blue'});try{const fsx=global.get('fs'),dir='/data/electric-log',file=dir+'/records.jsonl',nl=String.fromCharCode(10),lines=fsx.readFileSync(file,'utf8').split(nl).filter(Boolean);if(lines.length){const last=JSON.parse(lines[lines.length-1]),lastDate=Date.parse((last.date||'')+'T00:00:00');if(lastDate&&Date.now()-lastDate<3*86400000&&last.socEnd===100&&last.source==='node-red'){last.socEnd=newS;last.full=newS>=90;last.note=(last.note?last.note+'；':'')+'回填实际充后电量'+newS+'%';lines[lines.length-1]=JSON.stringify(last);const tmp=file+'.tmp';fsx.writeFileSync(tmp,lines.join(nl)+nl,{mode:0o600});fsx.renameSync(tmp,file);}}}catch(e){node.warn('回填充后电量失败：'+e.message);}return[msg,{payload:{soc:oldS}}];}return null;

name: 保存挂起数据
func: const fs=global.get('fs'),dir='/data/electric-log';try{fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true});}catch(e){}const battery=flow.get('nextChargeBattery','file')||'电池 A';flow.set('nextChargeBattery',battery==='电池 A'?'电池 B':'电池 A','file');const p={time:new Date().toISOString(),created:Date.now(),soc_before:flow.get('swapSocBefore','file'),mileage:Number(msg.payload)||null,battery:battery},file=dir+'/pending_swap.json',tmp=file+'.tmp';fs.writeFileSync(tmp,JSON.stringify(p,null,2),{mode:0o600});fs.renameSync(tmp,file);flow.set('curMile',p.mileage,'file');node.status({text:'挂起: '+battery+' 前'+p.soc_before+'% 里程'+p.mileage,fill:'blue'});msg.payload=p;return msg;

name: ② 插座充电会话：功率积分
info: sensor.0x00158d000926d0fa_power >8W 开始，<8W 持续 2 分钟确认结束，积分得到墙端度数（会话状态写入文件防重启丢失）。功率单位默认 W，若实体是 kW 请把 WATT_SCALE 改为 1000

name: 充电会话管理
等待 2 分钟确认结束
确认结束
func: const fs=global.get('fs'),file='/data/electric-log/charging_session.json',watts=Number(msg.payload);let s=null;try{s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'));}catch(e){}if(!s||!s.active)return null;function save(){const t=file+'.tmp';fs.writeFileSync(t,JSON.stringify(s),{mode:0o600});fs.renameSync(t,file);}if(Number.isFinite(watts)&&watts>8){delete s.candidateSince;delete s.ending;save();node.status({text:'继续充电',fill:'green'});return null;}s.ending=true;s.end_requested=Date.now();save();node.status({text:'正在读取结束电量',fill:'yellow'});msg.charge=s;return msg;

func: const secretFs=global.get('fs');let TOKEN='';try{TOKEN=JSON.parse(secretFs.readFileSync('/data/secure/node_red_secrets.json','utf8')).chargingApiToken||'';}catch(e){}const auth=String((msg.req&&msg.req.headers&&msg.req.headers.authorization)||''),supplied=auth.startsWith('Bearer ')?auth.slice(7):String((msg.req&&msg.req.query&&msg.req.query.token)||''),crypto=global.get('crypto'),valid=TOKEN&&supplied&&crypto&&Buffer.byteLength(TOKEN)===Buffer.byteLength(supplied)&&crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(TOKEN),Buffer.from(supplied)),headers={'Access-Control-Allow-Origin':'*','Content-Type':'application/json','Cache-Control':'no-store'};if(!valid){msg.statusCode=403;msg.payload={error:'forbidden'};msg.headers=headers;return msg;}const fsx=global.get('fs'),dir='/data/electric-log',file=String((msg.req&&msg.req.query&&msg.req.query.file)||'');if(!/^app_backup_\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\.json$/.test(file)){msg.statusCode=400;msg.payload={error:'invalid file'};msg.headers=headers;return msg;}try{const raw=fsx.readFileSync(dir+'/'+file,'utf8');if(Buffer.byteLength(raw,'utf8')>5*1024*1024)throw new Error('too large');msg.payload=JSON.parse(raw);msg.headers=headers;return msg;}catch(e){msg.statusCode=404;msg.payload={error:'backup not found'};msg.headers=headers;return msg;}
